rows: First pick, no contest. Unlocking it already boosts cash and coins, and its Golden Combo ability becomes your single biggest coin source.
Feels weak on unlock, becomes an economy and protector-killing pillar once its labs come in. Sync it with Golden Tower; the bonuses stack multiplicatively.
Strong at nearly every stage since its rework: coin bonus and health multiplier apply on hit, so it stays useful long after it stops killing.
A 3x coin bonus with constant uptime plus a serious damage multiplier through the mid game.
The king of crowd control. After its first activation it can stay up permanently. Second-biggest stone investment on my account for a reason.
Cheap to make strong; carries mid-game damage. On my CL-focused build it deals over half of all damage in logged runs.
A cheap, wide stun that keeps bosses and elites off you. 625 stones on my account bought a real effect. Shines in a damage meta, less in today's hybrid meta.
Reworked in v26; needs a developed Chrono Field to keep enemies in the swamp. Before that point it underperforms almost everything.

The classic guides call it the late-game damage ceiling, but the investment needed before it outperforms Chain Lightning is enormous, and in the current hybrid meta that payoff sits at the very end of the road. Last project on this list, and my account agrees: 0 stones.
